notes: Posted 28 May 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under Starting (8): This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further ('TDIGWATT/PIDAIAF'), Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber ('CCCarbonite Chamber'), All Wrapped Up, Secret Plans, Prepared Defenses ('Prepped Defenses'), Fanfare, I'm Sorry and Crush The Rebellion; these count toward the 60. Several Effects start and none is named as the starting Effect, so none is set.
Secret Plans and Fanfare are 2001 Effects (not Reflections III Defensive Shields), counted in the 60.
'Pod Racers1' is the section header (Pod Racers, 1 card), not a card.
Posted 'Emperor Pull-My-Finger' dested Emperor Palpatine (the only Emperor character in 2001; the strategy calls him 'Emperor').

Posted 'Zuckuss-n-boat', 'Dengar-n-boat', 'Boba Fett-n-boat' and 'IG-88-n-boat' dested Zuckuss In Mist Hunter, Dengar In Punishing One, Boba Fett In Slave I and IG-88 In IG-2000 (the starship listed under Ships).
Posted 'Bespin' dested the Dark Bespin system; 'BespinCC', 'CCWest Gallery', 'CCChasm Walkway' dested the Dark Bespin: Cloud City, Cloud City: West Gallery and Cloud City: Chasm Walkway.

Posted 'Tallon Roll/Dark Manuevers' dested Dark Maneuvers & Tallon Roll; 'Evader/Monok' dested Evader & Monnok; 'Sniper/Dark Strike' dested Sniper & Dark Strike; 'Ghhhk & TRWEU' dested Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us.

Posted 'Darth Maul' dested Darth Maul (Tatooine); 'Maul's Saber' dested Maul's Lightsaber; 'Aura Sing' dested Aurra Sing; 'Bane Molar' dested Bane Malar; '4-LOM w/ Gun' dested 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Sebulba's Racer' dested Sebulba's Podracer.
